title: Waste of money ...
text:
Waste of money .... Nice looking Farberware pizza cutter with a plastic handle.

A few weeks ago when I made pizza I had a hard time cutting our crisp pizza. Then this Farberware pizza cutter come up and I grabbed it.
Big mistake, it is worse then my Norpro pizza cutter that is not that old..
After going through a kitchen drawer, I found a small wood handle pizza cutter. Good Cook. ( think I bought it at a thrift store for under $1.00.
Omgosh the small, Good Cook pizza cutter went threw the Pizza easy without me having to struggle with it. I had to cut 2 large crisp pizzas.
What a pleasure using the little Good Cook cutter.
(My husband hurt his hand a few weeks ago and could not help me).

The Farberware looks good, but that’s all.
Don’t waste your money on this Farberware china junk.
One star.

product_metadata.title: Farberware Pro pizza cutter one size Aqua, 9.37-Inch
features: CUT CLEAN LINES IN YOUR PIZZA: The Farberware Professional Stainless Steel Pizza Cutter slices all your favorite pizza into perfect portions with precision and makes cutting pizza easy and effortless; works great with quesadilla, brownies, fudge and cookies too.
CUT THROUGH CRUST WITH EASE: The stainless steel blade cuts through thick crust with ease, and the plastic handle has a built-in finger and thumb guard; also bringing safety while in use.
NO MESS: The ergonomically designed handle is precisely weighted to elevate the head of the tool, keeping it off the countertop.
EASY TO CLEAN: Dishwasher safe, making clean up quick and easy.
description: This Farberware Pro Pizza Cutter effortlessly slices through pizza, pie crust, pastry dough, and more. The razor sharp, stainless steel blade creates even and neat cuts. Its handle is designed for comfort and control, and has a built-in finger and thumb guard for safety. The tip-up head keeps the blade from touching countertops when set down to keep your kitchen clean. Dishwasher safe.
